goal: Explain why you want to study in Korea, what you plan to study, how you will study, and what you will do after completion.

structure.instruction: Briefly state your academic background and current situation.
Explain the academic, research, or professional reason for choosing Korea.
State the exact program and the specific academic value it provides.
Mention institution-specific strengths, only if relevant and accurate.
Describe the subjects, skills, or research focus you plan to pursue.
Explain your realistic career direction after completing the program.
Restate your study intent briefly and professionally.

red_flags: Saying Korea was chosen mainly for convenience
Weak link between prior study and planned program
No clear academic reason for the specific university
Career plans that are too broad or unrealistic
Contradictions with transcripts, CV, or financial evidence
banned_phrases: I chose Korea because it is easy
I want to stay in Korea forever
This is my route to immigration
I do not know my career plan yet
Any course in Korea is fine
This university is my only option
I am applying just because of the visa
preferred_language: My academic background has prepared me for...
This program aligns with my interest in...
The curriculum provides the specialization I need in...
After completing this program, I intend to...
